content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
CommandLine
The command line used to create this process. May be empty in some circumstances, visit here [ http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-
us/library/windows/desktop/ms682425(v=vs.85).aspx] for more information.
AtJobId
Scheduled job identifier.
AtJobTime
Time of day at which the Windows At job is scheduled to run.
AtJobDaysOfMonth Days in month (CSV) which the Windows At job is scheduled to run.
AtJobDaysOfWeek
Weekdays (CSV) which the Windows At job is scheduled to run.
AtJobProperties
Windows At job properties.
Values:
JOB_RUN_PERIODICALLY (0x01)
JOB_EXEC_ERROR (0x02)
JOB_RUNS_TODAY (0x04)
JOB_ADD_CURRENT_DATE (0x08)
JOB_NONINTERACTIVE (0x10)
